messages.content: You are planner 2 in a competing plan pool. Produce an executable software mission DAG, not commentary.

PROGRAM OBJECTIVE: Complete readablePaths confinement across every read-like agent tool as one coupled source-and-test repair. Direct read refuses out-of-scope files. list_files at the territory root allows the empty relative root as traversal base but returns only walked files for which readAdmitted(file) is true. search at the territory root allows the empty relative root but reads only files for which readAdmitted(file) is true. A non-root requested list/search base is admitted only when that base itself is readAdmitted. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is absent. The exact source algorithm previously produced by a cloud actor uses `relativePath !== "" && !readAdmitted(relativePath)` for explicit-base refusal, `.filter(readAdmitted)` for list_files, and `if (!readAdmitted(file)) continue` inside search.

CONSTRAINTS: The single mission must edit src/agent-tools.mjs and create test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs.; Use relativePath !== empty-string to distinguish root traversal from an explicit non-root base.; Filter every list result and every searched file with readAdmitted.; Test both omitted path and explicit dot for root list_files and search.; Test exact-file and directory readablePaths, structured non-root refusals, and absence of protected names, bytes, and matching lines.; Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is empty and keep all existing tests green.
